question: Who among the following singers was called ‘Mallika-e-Ghazal’ or the queen of Ghazal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Begum Akhtar**__.

__
 
• **Begum Akhtar **singer was called** ‘Mallika-e-Ghazal’ or the queen of Ghazal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Akhtari Bai Faizabadi **is also known as Begum Akhtar, was an **Indian singer and actress**.
 
• Dubbed **"Mallika-e-Ghazal" (Queen of Ghazals)**, she is regarded as one of the greatest singers of **ghazal, Dadra, and thumri genres of Hindustani classical music**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Roshan Ara** Begum was a **vocalist **belonging to the **Kirana Gharana** (singing style) of Hindustani classical music.
 
• Iqbal Bano was a **ghazal singer from Pakistan** and she was known for her **semi-classical Urdu ghazal songs and classical thumris**.
 
• **Suraiya Jamal Sheikh**, popularly known by the mononym Suraiya, was a popular **actress and playback singer** in India's Hindi-language films.
